script_text: Stop—Taurus, the Moon is pressuring your steady earth nature right now. On November 17, Venus, your ruling planet, moves through your 10th House of career and authority while forming a supportive sextile to Jupiter in your 2nd House of money, helping practical work become visible to the right people. This is especially true if you have been quietly preparing behind the scenes. In love, this Venus-Jupiter flow invites generosity, but a tense square from Mars in your 6th House can make daily routines feel impatient; slow down before reacting. For career and money, your 10th House gains recognition for quality, and your 2nd House rewards careful pricing or a realistic budget. With Mercury touching your 8th House, share only what feels secure. Avoid impulsive purchases or arguments with coworkers; the blessing is a mentor-like person or client noticing your consistency. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
